reads.note: Pollinations image API: GET /prompt/ {prompt} (the space after the slash is the template's) with width, height, model, seed and nologo in the query; any prompt path on the origin is answered (any), since the prompt is model-written

models: AI Agent - Create Image From Prompt

expect.offline: Code - Clean Json keeps the text after each '"prompt":' in the agent's answer, so how many images are requested depends on the model's reply; with a reply that has none, Code - Get Prompt still emits one empty item (alwaysOutputData) and one request goes out for an empty prompt. Pollinations needs no credential. The Telegram trigger, Telegram reply and disk write are disabled in the template. The chat reply is the image request's output.
